repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(any(#TemperatureSensor).temperatureSensor_temperature < 30)
triggered = false
}
wait until(any(#TemperatureSensor).temperatureSensor_temperature >= 30)
all(#WindowCovering).windowCovering_downOrClose()
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a rising-edge wait on TemperatureSensor.Temperature >= 30. The candidate uses `all(#TemperatureSensor)` in the wait condition, but the initial state has Living_Temp at 30.0 and Bedroom_Temp at null. Since `all` requires the condition to be true for every bound device, the null value (treated as false) prevents the wait from ever completing, causing the action to be missed. The IR likely implies existential selection or the null is ignored in the rising edge logic, but the candidate's `all` quantifier is the strict cause of the failure at t=0.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wait condition from `all(#TemperatureSensor)` to `any(#TemperatureSensor)` to match the IR's implied behavior where a single sensor meeting the rising edge triggers the cycle. This allows the wait to complete when Living_Temp reaches 30, enabling the subsequent action.
